Frequently asked questions

These are the five questions buyers ask most often. Each answer states the number or the rule outright so you do not have to book a call to find out.

Ask a question we have not covered

How much does Brightpath Analytics cost?

Brightpath Analytics costs $480 per month on the Starter plan, $1,450 per month on Growth, and from $3,900 per month on Enterprise. There is no setup fee on any plan.

How long does implementation take?

Median implementation is 11 working days from contract signature to the first published forecast. Feed validation is the longest stage at 4 to 6 working days.

What data does Brightpath need?

Brightpath needs three feeds: point-of-sale transactions, on-hand inventory by location, and open purchase orders, with at least 12 months of SKU-level history.

Is there a minimum contract?

Starter and Growth are billed monthly and can be cancelled with 30 days notice. Enterprise is billed annually.

Who is Brightpath not a good fit for?

Brightpath is not a fit for single-store retailers, or for businesses without a digital inventory system, because the forecasts need at least 12 months of SKU-level history.
